errors.error_description: Declared a logic vector 'spare_debug' that is never read or driven anywhere else, making it an unused signal.
Used case equality (===) to compare 'data_in' against zero in RTL, which is non-synthesizable/unsafe for hardware and constitutes operator misuse.
In an always_comb block, 'tap_data' is conditionally assigned only when shift_en is high with no else/default assignment, causing an unintended latch.
